_readme: Seeded defects in sample_app/. Answer key for scoring the audit. Do not show this to Bob before the audit runs.

defects.summary: Login query built by string concatenation of email and password hash
searchByName concatenates the search term into a LIKE clause
Password policy accepts anything longer than 6 characters
JWT signing secret hardcoded in source
Login endpoint has no brute-force protection or rate limiting
Search term reflected into HTML without encoding
Admin user listing has no authentication or admin check
Error handler returns stack traces to the client
Session tokens valid for 30 days with no refresh or revocation

clean_by_design: sample_app/middleware/auth.js requireAuth verifies the token before trusting it

matching.rule: A finding matches a defect when file is equal, category is equal, and |finding.line - defect.line| <= 3.
matching.false_positive: A finding that matches no defect.
